fields.condition_text:
Ethical Use

I will use the STEP Together Protocol and its resources in alignment with the ethical standards and guidelines of my professional discipline and/or field of expertise or specialization.

Examples include, but are not limited to, the Canadian Psychological Association Code of Ethics, the College of Alberta Psychologists' Standards of Practice, the American Psychological Association's Ethical Principles, the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Alberta's Standards of Practice, the Alberta Teaching Profession Commission’s Code of Conduct, the Teaching Quality Standard, or the College of Registered Nurses of Alberta's Code of Ethics. This may also extend to other governing bodies, institutions, or organizations that define moral standards, conduct expectations, and ethical principles within their respective domains.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I have read, understood, and agreed to abide by these ethical guidelines.

fields.condition_text:
Responsibility for Client Welfare

I take full responsibility for the well-being and safety of all participants in my STEP Together groups. I will ensure that each client is appropriately supported throughout their involvement in the program. This includes monitoring and addressing any concerns related to mental health, safety, or emotional well-being. I will intervene appropriately if any participant shows signs of distress and, if necessary, refer them to the proper resources or professionals. I acknowledge and agree that Prepped 4 Learning Inc. is not responsible or liable for any participant’s well-being, actions, or outcomes during or after their participation in the STEP Together Protocol.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I agree to take full responsibility for the welfare of my clients and participants.

fields.condition_text:
Client Exclusion Criteria

I acknowledge the client exclusion criteria for the STEP Together Protocol and accept responsibility for ensuring that participants in my groups meet these criteria.

Exclusion Criteria: The STEP Together Protocol is not suitable for individuals experiencing suicidal thoughts or those diagnosed with psychotic or dissociative disorders.

If any participant experiences suicidal ideation, hallucinations, delusions, or dissociation, I will ensure they are referred to a mental health provider or physician.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I understand and acknowledge the client exclusion criteria and will ensure compliance.

fields.condition_text:
Participant Consent and Ethical Compliance

I will ensure all clients participating in the STEP Together Protocol complete an informed consent form that meets all requirements set out by my ethical standards and the guidelines of my professional discipline and/or my field of expertise or specialization. 

These requirements include but are not limited to, the Exclusion Criteria, confidentiality requirements, acknowledgment that the STEP Together Protocol is protected by copyright and intellectual property laws, prohibition of copying, duplication, or disclosure of any materials, information, or recordings related to the STEP Together Protocol, the limitations of technology and risks associated with its use, and the ability to ask questions for clarification and how to contact the group leader or group facilitators. Participants will not use the STEP Together intervention, or any part of it, for any other use other than their own personal guided self-help and information.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I will obtain informed consent from all participants in compliance with these requirements.

fields.condition_text:
Client Understanding and Acknowledgment

I will communicate the following understandings clearly to my clients:

It is not unusual for a memory to be linked to other unexpected personal issues that may come up during processing. The reprocessing of the targeted episode may lead to the emergence of other distressing memories during and after reviewing the STEP Together intervention. Clients will seek appropriate professional assistance if needed. The STEP Together Protocol is provided for guided self-help and informational purposes exclusively and is not intended for the purposes of therapy. Client participation and use of the STEP Together intervention does not create a professional-client relationship with the owner/creator of the videos and protocols (Prepped 4 Learning Inc.).
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I will communicate the above understandings clearly to my clients.

fields.condition_text:
Confidentiality

I will ensure the confidentiality of personal and clinical information shared during the program and enforce no recording or disclosure of any elements of the STEP Together Protocol by participants, group leaders, or facilitators and strict adherence to confidentiality in consultation sessions, practicum experiences, and group discussions. 

All participants, group leaders, and facilitators are expected to uphold the highest ethical standards of confidentiality concerning all personal and clinical information shared by others during this intervention. Confidentiality will also extend to all consultation sessions and practicum experiences. Specific details may only be discussed with members of the immediate consultation or practice group, the participant’s group consultant, the practicum supervisor, and the trainer(s) with permission from group participants and leaders/facilitators.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I understand and agree to enforce confidentiality requirements.

fields.condition_text:
Non-Distribution of Materials

The STEP Together Protocol is protected by copyright and/or other intellectual property laws. Copying, duplication, reproduction, or distribution, in any form, of the STEP Together Protocol, including, without limitation, all materials, information, and videos, is expressly prohibited. Recording of any nature and disclosure of any elements of the STEP Together Protocol is expressly prohibited.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I have read and agree to the non-distribution terms.

fields.condition_text:
Acknowledgment of Technology Risks

I understand and acknowledge the inherent risks associated with using technology, including but not limited to potential security breaches, data loss, unauthorized access, system outages, and digital data storage and transmission. While Prepped 4 Learning Inc. has implemented measures to safeguard the platform, I agree to take reasonable precautions to protect my access credentials and any sensitive data I interact with through the program.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I understand and acknowledge the technology risks.

fields.condition_text:
Prohibition of Misuse

I will not utilize the program or its resources in any way that could cause harm, misrepresentation, or violation of professional standards.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I agree to the prohibition of misuse of the program.

fields.condition_text:
Non-Transferability of Access

I will not share my login credentials or grant access to the program to any other individual, including other clinicians, who have not completed and submitted this agreement to Prepped 4 Learning Inc. I understand that sharing login information violates these terms and compromises the security and confidentiality of the program’s resources.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I understand and agree to the non-transferability of access.

fields.condition_text:
Limitations on Training Others

I understand that completing training in the use of this protocol does not grant me the authority or qualifications to train others in its application. I agree not to present myself as a trainer, instructor, or certifier of this protocol without explicit written authorization from Prepped 4 Learning Inc.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I understand and agree to the limitations on training others.

fields.condition_text:
Compliance with Local and Federal Laws

I affirm that I will use the STEP Together Protocol in compliance with all applicable local, provincial, state, and federal laws governing my practice.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I understand and agree to comply with all applicable laws.

fields.condition_text:
Feedback and Data Sharing

I agree to provide feedback on the STEP Together Protocol, including its feasibility, usability, and cost-effectiveness. This may include participating in feedback meetings and completing surveys or forms requested by Prepped 4 Learning Inc. I also agree to administer pre- and post-intervention measures (e.g., ITQ, PCL-5) as requested by Prepped 4 Learning Inc. Additionally, I agree to share anonymized data and written feedback with Prepped 4 Learning Inc. for potential use in publications, workshops, or other methods of dissemination at its discretion.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I agree to provide feedback and anonymized data as outlined above.

fields.condition_text:
Termination of Access

I understand that failure to adhere to these terms may result in immediate termination of my access to the STEP Together Protocol and its resources.
fields.confirmation_checkbox_text: I understand and agree to the termination of access policy.
